sceneSetting_1778153688926_3ku0k.description: A colorful and lively city street. On the left, a yellow building with a "CAFE" sign and flower boxes in the windows is visible. On the right, there is a red brick building with a large brown wooden door and white-framed windows. A wooden bench sits in the foreground on the gray sidewalk. A blue car is parked along the curb on the right.

sceneSetting_1778153839848_f3iii.description: A section of light green wall forms the left side, and a large brown door occupies most of the space on the right. A grey metal locking mechanism is located on the side of the door.

sceneSetting_1778153916810_g015y.description: Light green walls and a neutral grey floor. On the back wall, there is a window with a brown wooden frame and blue and white striped panes. To the right, a brown door is closed by a metal latch and a small grey padlock.

sceneSetting_1778154000874_44sc8.description: A city street seen in perspective under a clear blue sky. On the left, there is an orange building with a yellow and red striped awning, followed by a large purple building adorned with a circular sign reading "BANK".  On the right, a yellow building displays a large vertical white sign with the word "PIZZERIA". At the end of the street, the view continues with more buildings of various colors and a green tree.

sceneSetting_1778154258576_w7mld.description: A colorful urban street under a blue sky. Orange, yellow, and purple buildings are visible, one of which bears the sign "MARKET."  In the background, a large beige building is topped by an imposing communications antenna equipped with several satellite dishes. The ground is simply a gray sidewalk.

sceneSetting_1778165138914_axe7e.description: A street lined with colorful buildings: a purple shop with the sign "FLOWERS", a yellow building and a blue one. A red car is parked along a gray sidewalk.

sceneSetting_1778165486370_7ih0n.description: Grey road under a plain blue sky. In the background, a green tree can be seen on the left and beige, cube-shaped buildings on the right.

sceneSetting_1778165605237_eigmy.description: A large purple building with a sign reading "PATENT OFFICE." A wide white staircase leads to the building's glass entrance, which is decorated with a few potted plants.  In the foreground, a gray road is visible with a blue car parked on the right. A few bushes and small trees add a touch of greenery along the sidewalk.

sceneSetting_1778166289240_gdq46.description: Inside a building, identified by the inscription "PATENT OFFICE" on a back wall. The floor is covered with a blue carpet, and the ceiling is fitted with several rectangular light fixtures.  There is a brown reception desk, a waiting area with purple seating, and a surveillance camera mounted high on the ceiling. To the left, a large bay window lets in light, while green plants decorate the space.

sceneSetting_1778166376403_g6rec.description: An indoor waiting room with cream-colored walls and a blue floor. Several rows of purple chairs are lined up along the walls.  In the background, a brown door with a round, silver handle is visible.

sceneSetting_1778166526465_87k56.description: A beige-yellow wall in the background with purple chair backs

sceneSetting_1778166643129_k8amw.description: A light beige wall is adorned with a large window with blue and white striped panes. Several purple chair backs are lined up along the wall.

sceneSetting_1778166784892_kxxhd.description: The facade of a purple building bears the inscription "PATENT OFFICE." A wide white staircase leads to an entrance with glass doors framed by potted plants. To the right, a green space includes a lawn bordered by bushes, a tree, and a wooden bench. Gray sidewalks separate the different traffic and rest areas.

sceneSetting_1778167469531_0di3b.description: Grey road and a white sidewalk.

sceneSetting_1778167612918_2rl25.description: The facade of a purple building bearing the sign "PATENT OFFICE" forms the background. A white staircase leads to a glass-enclosed entrance surrounded by potted green plants.  Windows with blue and white striped panes punctuate the walls. Vegetation grows along the sides, including a tree on the left and bushes at the base of the building.
